vertical_slice.hypothesis: A Figma development plugin can export one selected Frame into a compact Dresser editor, preserve the existing mockup and customization choices, and place the rendered PNG back beside the source Frame.
vertical_slice.demo_outcome: In Figma Desktop, select one Frame, open the Dresser plugin, choose a mockup and background in a plugin-sized interface, then insert the resulting PNG beside the selected Frame.

goal: Package Dresser as a Figma plugin that turns selected Figma Frames into configured mockup PNGs and places them back on the canvas.
do: Create a development-loadable Figma plugin with a main-thread selection and canvas bridge
Adapt the Dresser interface to a compact Figma plugin window
Preserve the existing mockups, device settings, backgrounds, mesh palette, layout controls, and PNG rendering
Insert the generated PNG beside the source Frame with a predictable name and position
keep: Keep the existing interactive Dresser mirror and browser MCP usable
Do not alter unrelated portfolio work
Do not publish the plugin to Figma Community, push, or deploy in this slice
Do not add batch or multi-frame processing before the first demo
success: Figma Desktop imports the development plugin without manifest errors
One selected Frame is exported into the plugin and shown in the Dresser preview
The compact interface exposes the preserved mockup and customization controls
The generated PNG is inserted beside the source Frame and matches the preview
The existing local Dresser and MCP regression checks still pass
